comparator.k_source: Minimum fixed-K budget observed to achieve 90/90 exactness on the existing primary 90-field 1deg held-out benchmark

configuration_B.source: John Deere 3033R official specifications: turning radius without brakes 2.8 m
configuration_B.engineering_rationale: A 40% larger, manufacturer-grounded no-brake turning radius represents a less maneuverable but plausible compact agricultural tractor while isolating one vehicle-geometry factor.

A1_A4_config_B.A1_SWATH_PRESERVATION: PASS: turning radius is consumed only by path planning; geometry, headland, decomposition, coverage width and swath generator are unchanged.
A1_A4_config_B.A2_ENDPOINT_CONNECTED_TRANSITIONS: PASS: pinned PathPlanning passes each swath end/start pose to TurningBase::createTurn; Dubins endpoints are corrected to the requested points.
A1_A4_config_B.A3_CONTINUOUS_CONNECTED_TRAVERSAL: PASS: path concatenates swaths and Dubins transition paths in route order; changing positive radius changes curvature only.
A1_A4_config_B.A4_NONNEGATIVE_PATH_DECOMPOSITION: PASS: Path::length sums fabs(state.len), while swath segment lengths and transition lengths are nonnegative.
A1_A4_config_B.source_review: Pinned Fields2Cover commit 92b9f2f path_planning.cpp, turning_base.cpp, dubins_curves.cpp, Robot.cpp, Path.cpp, pp_objective.cpp

selection.rule: Within each source geometry family, allocate target counts by proportional largest remainder (at least one from each nonempty family when feasible), then choose deterministic equal-area-rank-bin midpoints with source_path tie-break.
